summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PDF generation and E-Fatura features. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All PDF download buttons and E-Fatura button working correctly. Fixed frontend bug where E-Fatura endpoint was incorrect.
critical_code_review_comments: PDF generation using fpdf2 library works correctly for quotes, invoices, and service reports
Quote accept endpoint correctly creates invoice from quote items
E-Fatura (BizimHesap) integration properly validates Firm ID configuration before sending
All PDF endpoints return proper content-type headers and file attachments
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created quotes and invoices during testing. Test data prefixed with 'TEST' for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF generation and E-Fatura features fully tested. Frontend tests verified: Quote list PDF download button, Quote accept button with invoice creation, Invoice detail PDF download button, Invoice detail E-Fatura button, Ticket detail Service Report PDF button.
